# Dr. AI Hub for Gemini and Antigravity

Find doctors in Egypt by city and specialty, and read condition and medicine pages in Arabic and English, from [draihub.com](https://draihub.com).

This repository is both a **Gemini CLI extension** (`gemini-extension.json`) and an **Antigravity plugin** (`plugin.json` + `mcp_config.json`). Both connect to the Dr. AI Hub MCP server.

- Public server (no sign-in): `https://draihub.com/mcp`
- Account server (sign in with a Dr AI account, read only): `https://draihub.com/mcp/account`

## Tools (all read only)
- `search_doctors`, `get_doctor`: listed doctors by Egyptian city and specialty, with profile links. No phone numbers.
- `list_specialties`, `list_cities`
- `search_health_topics`, `get_health_topic`: condition and medicine pages, including Egyptian brand names.
- `about_dr_ai_hub`
- Signed in: `my_account`, `my_appointment_requests`, `my_saved_doctors`; doctors `requests_from_patients`, `my_doctor_listing`; clinic staff `my_clinics`, `clinic_day_schedule`, `clinic_numbers`.

## Install
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/alionour/dr-ai-hub-gemini`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/alionour/dr-ai-hub-gemini`
- Gemini app (gemini.google.com, where Google offers custom apps): Settings > Connected Apps > Add a custom app > `https://draihub.com/mcp`

## Example prompts
- "Find a cardiologist in Cairo on Dr. AI Hub"
- "What does Dr. AI Hub say about type 2 diabetes, and which doctor should I see?"
- "ابحث عن دكتور أسنان في سوهاج"

Health information is general, not a diagnosis. In an emergency in Egypt, call 123.

Privacy: https://draihub.com/en/health/privacy · Terms: https://draihub.com/en/health/terms · Support: support@draihub.com
